record.question: Which of the following is the official emblem for Beijing 2022 Olympic Winter Games?
record.explanation: Answer B: Winter Dream. Winter Dream is the Beijing 2022 Winter Olympic Games emblem. The IOC’s original reference collection identifies that name, designer Lin Cunzhen, and unveiling 15 December 2017. Historical/source note: Olympic emblem; the separate Paralympic emblem was Flying High. Reference: https://library.olympics.com/digitalCollection/DigitalCollectionAttachmentDownloadHandler.ashx?documentId=619770&parentDocumentId=619769&skipCopyright=true&skipWatermark=true. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
